From explicitly verified 24 vertices and 24 halfspaces |x_i|+|x_j|≤1, each of 24 supporting facets has six vertices forming a regular octahedron of 3-volume √2/3 (also independently stated in Novaga–Song Lemma 2.3). Cauchy’s four-dimensional facet projection formula gives b(u)=1/3 Σ_{i<j}(|u_i+u_j|+|u_i−u_j|)=2/3(3a1+2a2+a3) for ordered absolute coordinates. Cauchy–Schwarz gives sharp maximum 2√14/3, equality only a∝(3,2,1,0), with 4!·2³=192 signed directions. For minimum, decompose ordered cone in rays g1=(1,0,0,0),g2=(1,1,0,0),g3=(1,1,1,0),g4=(1,1,1,1); L(g_j)/||g_j|| equals (3,5/√2,2√3,3), and triangle equality forces only g1 or g4. Hence min=2 with exactly 8+16=24 directions. Independently enumerated all facets and vertex counts; no sampling used as substitute for analytic extrema. Directions are oriented u and −u counted separately.
